title: Negated extglob with a star followed by more pattern never matches
prompt: Our picomatch can't match a path against a negated extglob that contains a star when something follows the closing parenthesis. For example '/!(*.d).ts' should match '/file.something.ts' but not '/file.d.ts', and '/!(*.d).{ts,tsx}' or '/!(*.d).@(ts)' behave the same way (they should match '/file.dhello.ts' and '/file.d.something.ts', but not '/file.d.ts'). Please fix it.
